content.short: Collect different factions of supernatural characters each with their own theme song!
content.description:
A limited series of hand-drawn artworks by Good Charlotte guitarist Billy Martin. Billy also works as a freelance illustrator for Marvel, Disney, Nickelodeon, Hasbro and more. Each NFT comes with an MP3 soundtrack by Billy to accompany the characters.

This drop is expanding on our S1 release by adding a 3D variant and 3 new characters into the collection!
